payload.summary_zh: 桐灼GEO 1.0.1 是产品自有版本线的首个发布：以 GEOFlow 为业务与技术底座，后台界面统一为 React 单页应用，旧 Blade 管理面完成退役。包含知识库 RAG 检索、AI 内容生成与人工审核质检门禁、多端分发、AI 爬虫与可见性监测，后台全部真实调用 api/v1。
payload.summary_en: TongzhuoGEO 1.0.1 is the first release on the product's own version line: GEOFlow as the business and technical foundation, a React single-page application as the sole admin surface, and the legacy Blade admin fully retired. It covers knowledge-base RAG retrieval, AI content generation with human review and quality gating, multi-channel distribution, and AI crawler/visibility monitoring, all served by the real api/v1 backend.
payload.upgrade_tip_zh: 升级前备份数据库、.env、上传目录和 storage，停机排空旧进程后执行 php artisan migrate --force；随后运行 php artisan geoflow:security-audit 与 php artisan optimize，重新构建前端，并重启应用、queue worker、调度器与 Reverb。本版本把后台入口统一到 /geo_admin，旧 /legacy-admin 已退役并返回 404；更新检查指向本产品仓库，需确认该仓库已发布带 version.json 资产的 release，否则更新检查会返回 status=error。
payload.upgrade_tip_en: Back up the database, .env, uploads, and storage, drain old processes, then run php artisan migrate --force. Afterwards run php artisan geoflow:security-audit and php artisan optimize, rebuild frontend assets, and restart the application, queue workers, scheduler, and Reverb. This release consolidates the admin surface under /geo_admin; the legacy /legacy-admin is retired and returns 404. The update check targets this product repository, so make sure it has a published release carrying the version.json asset, otherwise the check reports status=error.
